div.head: IV As 7
div.ab: Et si quis prepositus hoc non fecerit (disperdat) nec inde curam habuerit (adhibeat), det regi centum uiginti solidos, si per uerum recitetur super eum, et etiam indecencia perferat, sicut dictum est (diximus). Et si thainus sit qui hoc faciat uel aliquis alius, sit hoc idem.

[De infringentibus ista statuta et eorum pœna.] [Q/Br] Et si quis præpositus hoc non fecerit nec inde curam habuerit, det regi centum viginti solidos, si per verum recitetur super eum, et etiam indecentia perferat, sicut dictum est. Et si thainus sit qui hoc faciat vel aliquis alius, sit hoc idem.

And if any reeve will neither carry out nor show sufficient regard for this [ordinance], he shall give 120 shillings to the king if the accusation against him is substantiated, and suffer also such disgrace as has been ordained. And if it is a thegn or anyone else who acts thus, the same punishment shall be inflicted.
div.note: Latin only; no German translation in Liebermann. Liebermann compares II As 25; V As 1.2–1.4.
